name: Eliza no Kusari
source:
Haruto is a guy whose life is constantly changing. His father has got a new wife and now 
all have moved to a new house. On the day of the move, Haruto finds 
input to cross to the next house. This is where the hero will be involved 
in situations that would lead him to meet Elizabeth, a strange girl who decides to love. 
Unaware that behind it, there's more ...
